  1. Wei T, Nie J, Larson NB, Ye Z, Eckel-Passow JE, Robertson KD, Kocher JPA, Wang L. CpGtools: a Python package for DNA methylation analysis. Bioinformatics. 2020;36(5):1598–1599. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btz916.

  2. Ma T, Nie J, Huang J, Zhang YB, Biernacka JM, Wang L. Multi-output learning for systematic missing value imputation in DNA methylation arrays. Bioinformatics Advances. 2026;6(1):vbag052. Published February 15, 2026. doi:10.1093/bioadv/vbag052.
